title: Social, Language and Knowledge Identity Hooks
objective: Connect species identity to reputation/relationship/law/faction/knowledge systems without encoding culture or behavioral stereotypes as biology.
acceptance: biological communication and learned languages are distinct
observer knowledge can hide canonical identity
boundaries: MVPS-11 owns species-facing social, language and knowledge identity hooks only; canonical Relationship/Reputation/Law/Faction/Knowledge systems remain with their shared owners.
Culture, norms, profession, ideology and learned behavior remain separable from biology and may not be inferred from species identity.
Biological communication capabilities and learned languages must remain distinct, with exact source/provenance references.
Observer knowledge/visibility may conceal or misidentify canonical species identity; MVPS-11 must not leak hidden truth.
Progression/maturation remains MVPS-10; validation/migration remains MVPS-12; runtime active contribution projection remains MVPS-13.
MVPS-12+ remain unauthorized until separately selected.
next_action: On an MVPS-specific owner Continue, enter through OPS3, reserve the FIFO publication turn before candidate preparation, fresh-read MVPS-01 through MVPS-10 plus current Relationship/Reputation/Law/Faction/Knowledge/Language owner contracts, then govern-start MVPS-11 and execute the bounded tranche.
